'''0.1''' is the first major release for [[Survarium]] that included the [[Teamplay]] mode, the [[Vostok Radar Station]] [[Locations|location]] and the [[Scavengers]] and [[Black Market]] factions.

==Changelog==
* [[Teamplay]] mode (PvP)
* Two factions ([[Scavengers camp|Scavengers]] and [[Black market]])
* One in-game [[locations|location]] ([[Vostok Radar Station]])
* 11 types of [[weapons]]
* 3 sets of [[equipment]] for Scavengers and Black Market
* [[Hero#Damage_system|Location-based damage]]
* Draft version of user interface
